'''Foreman Crusher''' was the name given to a massive [[Kintan crusher]] who guarded the entrance to the [[Nal Hutta droid factory|droid factory]] in the [[Karagga's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] leader, [[Karagga]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] after the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Foreman Crusher was kept chained up by members of Karagga's [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]]. When a group of interlopers stormed the palace, they overwhelmed Foreman Crusher and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Kintan crusher.<ref name="SWTOR" />
